criteria.title: Greeting and introduction
criteria.description: Names the company and themselves at the start; on outbound calls also says why they are calling.

criteria.title: Needs discovery
criteria.description: Asks about the application, size or airflow, constraints (noise, controls, existing ducts) and the deadline before recommending anything. 1 = some questions, but key facts were never asked.

criteria.title: Relevant recommendation
criteria.description: Recommends a specific product or solution and ties it to what the customer said. 1 = a product is named without a reason, or only a price range is given.

criteria.title: Objection handling
criteria.description: Answers concerns about price, lead time or need with facts and alternatives. Giving in with a discount or a promise nobody checked counts as 0. Not applicable if the customer raised no concerns.

criteria.title: Agreed next step
criteria.description: Ends with a concrete next action, who does it and when (a day or date). 1 = an action without a date, or a vague 'let's talk later'.

criteria.title: Listening and tone
criteria.description: Lets the customer finish, confirms what was said, stays polite and patient. 0 = repeatedly interrupts or is dismissive.

criteria.title: Policy compliance
criteria.description: No discount above 5% without the head of sales' approval, no delivery date earlier than the stock status allows, no card details taken over the phone. 0 = any of these happened.
